name: calm
title: Calm
note: A shell theme for long sessions: soft lines, a gentle lift for what floats, moderate rounding, colour kept for meaning.

name: refined-grotesk
title: Refined, in Space Grotesk
note: Refined with a different face for interface text, to compare.

name: refined-plex
title: Refined, in IBM Plex Sans
note: Refined with a different face for interface text, to compare.

name: refined-ported
title: Refined, tokens only
note: Refined without its patch, for components that already carry the changes (add bundle=ported).

name: refined
title: Refined
note: Round two: a plain UI face, one control height, three type sizes, and depth in named levels (well, page, band, key, raised, floating) in place of outlines.

name: ruled
title: Ruled
note: The site in print: a 3px corner on controls, square panels, one resting rule under a field, ink on mint for what is chosen, hard shadows only under what floats.

name: touch
title: Touch
note: Soft keys on paper: rounded, a little taller, filled with a quiet tint instead of outlined, with soft depth instead of hard edges.
